nominee.shortDescription: Some say the most gentle celebrity
nominee.longerDescription: HAPPY WW! This week I am nominating a woman I have discovered previously but never really got the hype till now. Many say she is the brown skinned version of Jenna, maybe thats why I resisted becuase I didn't want to choose between my 2 fav snacks you know? But I do agree with the comparisons and I have seen some videos of her talking about her films and views and she seems to be really nice. She always talks about being gentle to one another and being patient and many say she has a calming aura. Lowkey hasn't seen her in any movie before but I do plan on watching at least one for the plot! Lowkey gives me the vibe of the girl you date young and don't appreciate and will forever yearn for :D  Hype 8/10
